# protoc.generate searches the -I paths in flags for imports after include,
# leaves well-known types to protoc, and tracks a -o descriptor set.
[!exec:protoc] skip
[!exec:protoc-gen-go] skip

bit
stdout 'gen ✔ ok'
exists gen/api/event.pb.go desc.pb
# The runner's grep reads text only, and a descriptor set is binary.
exec grep -q google/protobuf/timestamp.proto desc.pb

bit
stdout 'gen · no changes'

cp tag.proto.changed vendor/ext/tag.proto
bit
stdout '''vendor/ext/tag\.proto'' changed'
exec grep -q Label desc.pb

rm desc.pb
bit
stdout '''desc\.pb'' \(removed\) changed'
exists desc.pb

# A descriptor set the flags no longer name is removed, and --clean removes
# the one they do.
cp BUILD.bit.renamed BUILD.bit
bit
stdout 'gen ✔ ok'
exists set.pb
! exists desc.pb

bit --clean
! exists set.pb gen/api/event.pb.go
exists api/event.proto

-- BUILD.bit.renamed --
gen = protoc.generate {
  sources = ["api/*.proto"]
  include = ["."]
  out     = { go = "gen" }
  opt     = { go = "paths=source_relative" }
  flags   = ["-Ivendor", "--include_imports", "--descriptor_set_out=set.pb"]
}
-- BUILD.bit --
gen = protoc.generate {
  sources = ["api/*.proto"]
  include = ["."]
  out     = { go = "gen" }
  opt     = { go = "paths=source_relative" }
  flags   = ["-Ivendor", "--include_imports", "-odesc.pb"]
}
-- api/event.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package api;
option go_package = "example.com/api";

import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto";
import "ext/tag.proto";

message Event {
  google.protobuf.Timestamp at = 1;
  ext.Tag tag = 2;
}
-- vendor/ext/tag.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package ext;
option go_package = "example.com/ext";

message Tag {
  string value = 1;
}
-- tag.proto.changed --
syntax = "proto3";
package ext;
option go_package = "example.com/ext";

message Tag {
  string value = 1;
}

message Label {
  string name = 1;
}
